name: navigation-menu
useFor: Use for a site's main navigation when some entries open a panel of related links (Product, Developers). Give each link in a panel a title and a NavigationMenuLinkDescription. Set tray for the header's glass tray, and active on the current page's link.
constraints: Actions in the menu (use a dropdown menu)
Panels with more than eight links
title: Navigation Menu
description: Site links with panels, drawn as the header's links, optionally in its frosted tray.
